caption_L1: This line chart is titled Life expectancy (from birth) in Mexico , from 1890 to 2020. The x-axis shows Year while the y-axis plots Life expectancy in years.
caption_L2L3: Life expectancy in Mexico has more than tripled since 1890. There has been a consistently steady rise since 1920 but this has levelled off since the beginning the 21st century.
